question: How many practices does Trafford Dental Group have?

resolution.read_instruction: Extract every statement about how many dental practices, clinics, surgeries or locations Trafford Dental Group operates, including any hedges or approximate figures.
assumptions: The question concerns the Trafford Dental Group cold call (CALL-019); 'practices' is treated as a synonym for clinics or locations.

findings.speaker: Yvonne Deeks
findings.context: Trafford Dental Group has eleven practices. — Customer correction of the vendor's figure of fourteen; stated directly by the customer who works there.

findings.speaker: Alastair McCrae
findings.quote: I had a look at Trafford Dental and you've grown quite a bit, haven't you, you're what, fourteen practices now?
findings.context: Vendor initially claimed Trafford Dental has fourteen practices, based on outside research rather than the customer. — Vendor's wrong figure, later corrected by the customer; vendor said it came from looking at the company.

findings.speaker: Yvonne Deeks
findings.quote: You didn't know how many practices we have.
findings.context: Customer reiterates the group has eleven practices and criticises the vendor for not knowing how many practices they have. — Customer contradicts the vendor's fourteen figure in the course of complaining about the vendor's lack of research.

findings.speaker: Alastair McCrae
findings.context: Vendor acknowledged the practice count was wrong. — Vendor concedes the point after the customer's challenge.

findings.speaker: Yvonne Deeks
findings.quote: Not the number of practices off a website.
findings.context: Customer says the vendor's practice count came from a website, not real knowledge of the group. — Customer's criticism that the figure was taken from public sources.

draft.answer: Trafford Dental Group has eleven practices, according to Yvonne Deeks, its Practice Operations Manager [C1]. OrbitFlow's Alastair McCrae had wrongly said fourteen, based on his own outside research, and he later conceded the figure was wrong [C2][C3].

claims.text: Yvonne Deeks (Practice Operations Manager, Trafford Dental Group) stated the group has eleven practices, and repeated this later in the call when she criticised the vendor for not knowing the number.

Alastair McCrae (OrbitFlow Account Executive) initially said Trafford Dental had fourteen practices, saying he got this from looking at the company. Deeks said the figure came from a website rather than real knowledge of the group.
After Deeks challenged him, McCrae acknowledged the practice count was wrong ("That's — yeah, fair.").

conflicts.description: McCrae said fourteen; Deeks corrected it to eleven. McCrae later conceded the count was wrong, which settles it in favour of eleven.
